Name: DE-Types
Statement:
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.JobType)
select  j.Oid as TypeId,
        j.Oid as DocumentOid,
        j.Name as Type, 
        j.Code, 
        j.DurationDays, 
        j.Active,
        j.IsRetainer,
        j.Plannable,
        j.IsDeliverable,
        j.AllowAllJobTypes,
        j.CreatedOn,
        j.ModifiedOn,
        bt.Name as BriefingTemplate,
        bt.Oid as BriefingTemplateId,
        bot.[Name] as BusinessObjectType,
        bot.[Oid] as BusinessObjectTypeId,
        c.Name as Company,
        c.Oid as CompanyId, 
        v.Name as Division,
        v.Oid as DivisionId,
        d.Name as Department,
        d.Oid as DepartmentId,
        doc.Name as Document,
        doc.Oid as DocumentId,
        w.Name as Workflow,
        w.Oid as WorkflowId,
        u.Name as CreatedByName,
        us.Name as ModifiedByName,
        u.Id as CreatedById,
        us.Id as ModifiedById,
        u.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        us.HasImage as ModifiedByHasImage,
        j.StyleJson as TypeStyle,
        j.AccessibleToAllDepartments as AccessibleToAllDepartments,
        j.AllowsTimesheet,
        ar.Oid as ServiceId,
        ar.Name as Service,
        wt.Name as WorkType,
        wt.Oid as WorkTypeId
from    JobType j
            left join Department d on j.Department = d.Oid
            left join Company c on d.Company = c.Oid
            left join Division v on d.Division = v.Oid
            left join Document doc on j.Document = doc.Oid
            left join DocumentType w on j.Workflow = w.Oid
            left join BusinessObjectType bot on j.BusinessObjectType = bot.Oid
            left join BriefingTemplate bt on j.BriefingTemplate = bt.Oid
            left join UserLookup u on u.Id = j.CreatedBy 
            left join UserLookup us on us.Id = j.ModifiedBy
            left join Article ar on ar.Oid = j.Article
            left join WorkType wt on wt.Oid = j.WorkType
where   j.GCRecord is null
